_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. The directory stage is a keyless WordPress.org JSON API (no browser, no proxy); only optional email enrichment fetches homepages, done cheaply in a bounded parallel pool. High volume, so prices are low. First 10 qualified_lead per run are free for validation. | 2026-08-17 pass: per-run free allowance cut to 1 (0 where average output is under ~2 rows/run). It is charged per run, not per user, so on low-yield actors it was zeroing out revenue. Descriptions corrected to match src/main.js. Effective 09-01.

listing.eventDescription: One plugin or theme with author, active installs, rating, downloads, and maintenance signals, but no company website.

lead.eventDescription: A plugin or theme with the author's company website, plus installs, rating, downloads, and maintenance signals.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: A plugin with a scraped contact email and active installs at or above the qualified bar. A reachable, established developer. The first qualified lead per run is free so you can validate output.
